Then creation will share the freedom of God's children, when they receive their glory.

es.L: Porque la creación quedó sometida a la frustración, no por su voluntad, sino por causa del que [la] sometió, en esperanza \v 21 de que también la creación misma será liberada de la esclavitud de la decadencia hacia la libertad de la gloria de los hijos de Dios.
es.B: La creación quedó sometida a la frustración. No fue por decisión propia; fue por causa de aquel que la sometió. Pero había esperanza: \v 21 la creación misma también será liberada de su esclavitud a la decadencia y entrará en la libertad que acompaña a la gloria de los hijos de Dios.
es.R: La creación quedó sometida a cosas que no llegan a nada. No lo eligió. Dios lo dispuso así, pero también le dio esperanza a la creación. \v 21 Un día la creación será liberada de la decadencia, que la tiene atada como a una esclava. Entonces la creación compartirá la libertad de los hijos de Dios, cuando ellos reciban su gloria.

fr.L: Car la création a été soumise à la vanité, non de son plein gré, mais à cause de celui qui [l’y] a soumise, dans l’espérance \v 21 que la création elle-même aussi sera libérée de l’esclavage de la corruption pour la liberté de la gloire des enfants de Dieu.
fr.B: La création a été soumise à une existence vaine. Ce n’était pas son choix ; c’était à cause de celui qui l’y a soumise. Mais il restait une espérance : \v 21 la création elle-même sera, elle aussi, libérée de son esclavage à la corruption, et elle entrera dans la liberté qui accompagne la gloire des enfants de Dieu.
fr.R: La création a été soumise à des choses qui ne mènent à rien. Elle ne l’a pas choisi. C’est Dieu qui l’a voulu ainsi, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a aussi donné une espérance à la création. \v 21 Un jour, la création sera libérée de la destruction, qui la tient comme une esclave. Alors la création partagera la liberté des enfants de Dieu, quand ils recevront leur gloire.

sw.L: Kwa maana uumbaji ulitiishwa chini ya hali ya kukosa maana, si kwa kutaka kwake bali kwa sababu ya yule aliyeutiisha, katika tumaini \v 21 kwamba uumbaji wenyewe pia utawekwa huru kutoka katika utumwa wa kuoza kuelekea uhuru wa utukufu wa watoto wa Mungu.
sw.B: Uumbaji ulifanywa kuwa chini ya hali ya kukosa maana. Haukuchagua hivyo wenyewe; ilikuwa kwa sababu ya yule aliyeutiisha. Hata hivyo kulikuwa na tumaini: \v 21 uumbaji wenyewe pia utafunguliwa kutoka katika utumwa wake wa kuoza, na kuingia katika uhuru unaoambatana na utukufu wa watoto wa Mungu.
sw.R: Uumbaji ulifanywa kuwa chini ya mambo yasiyofikia lengo lolote. Haukuchagua hali hiyo. Mungu aliifanya iwe hivyo, lakini pia aliupa uumbaji tumaini. \v 21 Siku moja uumbaji utawekwa huru kutoka katika kuoza, kunakoushikilia kama mtumwa. Ndipo uumbaji utashiriki uhuru wa watoto wa Mungu, watakapopokea utukufu wao.

decisions.choice: futility: emptiness, failing to reach its purpose
decisions.reason: mataiotēs is what is empty and comes to nothing, the word of Ecclesiastes 1:2 in the Greek Old Testament ("vanity of vanities"). Creation cannot be what it was made to be.

decisions.choice: the one who subjected it: God, when he cursed the ground
decisions.reason: Paul refers to Genesis 3:17-19, where God cursed the ground because of Adam. Only God could subject creation "in hope". Some think of Adam, whose sin brought this about; but the hope fits God, who judged and promised at once.

decisions.choice: that creation will be set free: the content of the hope
decisions.reason: hoti can mean "that" or "because". Read as "that", it says what creation hopes for; read as "because", it gives the reason for hope. The sense is close either way.

decisions.choice: the slavery of decay: bondage to decay and death
decisions.reason: phthora is decay and corruption, everything that falls apart and dies. Creation is held by it as a slave is held.

decisions.choice: the freedom of the glory of the children of God: the freedom that comes when they are glorified
alternatives: the glorious freedom of God's children
decisions.reason: The phrase links freedom with the glory of verse 18. Creation will share the freedom that God's children enter when their glory is revealed.

decisions.choice: God made it so, but he also gave creation hope
alternatives: because of the one who subjected it
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who subjected creation (m2) and so needs a deity pronoun for him.

decisions.choice: things that come to nothing
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word (m1).

decisions.choice: frustración; decadencia
decisions.reason: Futility is emptiness, failing to reach a purpose (m1). "Vanidad", the older wording, now means conceit to most readers; "frustración" says that creation is kept from its goal. For the decay of verse 21 (m4), "decadencia" is used, since "corrupción" is now heard first as dishonesty.

decisions.choice: la vanité (L); une existence vaine (B); des choses qui ne mènent à rien (R)
decisions.reason: The word means emptiness, failing to reach a purpose (m1). French "futilité" today means frivolity, and "vanité" alone is mostly read as conceit, so Literal keeps the biblical "vanité" (as in Ecclesiastes) and Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: hali ya kukosa maana (L, B); mambo yasiyofikia lengo (R); kuoza
decisions.reason: Futility is emptiness, failing to reach a purpose (m1); "hali ya kukosa maana" (a state of having no meaning) says it in plain words, where "ubatili" is a church word many readers do not use. Decay (m4) is "kuoza" (rotting), the everyday word for things that fall apart and die.

decisions.choice: slave(s), slavery
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it where slavery itself is the point: slavery to decay set against the freedom of the glory of God's children (8:21).

source.text: οἴδαμεν γὰρ ὅτι πᾶσα ἡ κτίσις συστενάζει καὶ συνωδίνει ἄχρι τοῦ νῦν·

records.literal_gloss: We know for that all the creation groans together and travails together until the now;

en.L: For we know that all the creation groans together and suffers birth pains together until now.
en.B: We know that all creation, to this very day, groans as one and suffers the pains of giving birth together.
en.R: We know that everything God made has been crying out in pain until now, like a woman giving birth to a baby.

es.L: Porque sabemos que toda la creación gime en conjunto y sufre en conjunto dolores de parto hasta ahora.
es.B: Sabemos que toda la creación, hasta el día de hoy, gime como un solo cuerpo y sufre a la vez los dolores de dar a luz.
es.R: Sabemos que todo lo que Dios hizo ha estado gritando de dolor hasta ahora, como una mujer que está dando a luz.

fr.L: Car nous savons que toute la création gémit ensemble et souffre ensemble les douleurs de l’enfantement jusqu’à maintenant.
fr.B: Nous savons que toute la création, jusqu’à ce jour, gémit d’une seule voix et souffre ensemble les douleurs de l’accouchement.
fr.R: Nous savons que tout ce que Dieu a fait n’a pas cessé de crier de douleur jusqu’à maintenant, comme une femme qui met un enfant au monde.

sw.L: Kwa maana tunajua kwamba uumbaji wote unaugua pamoja na kuumwa uchungu wa kuzaa pamoja hadi sasa.
sw.B: Tunajua kwamba uumbaji wote, hadi leo hii, unaugua kwa pamoja na kuteseka pamoja kwa uchungu wa kuzaa.
sw.R: Tunajua kwamba kila kitu ambacho Mungu aliumba kimekuwa kikilia kwa maumivu hadi sasa, kama mwanamke anayejifungua mtoto.

decisions.choice: groans and suffers birth pains: pain that leads to new life
decisions.reason: Birth pains are a common biblical picture for the distress before God's new age (Isaiah 26:17-19; Mark 13:8). They hurt, but they mean something is about to be born.

decisions.choice: together: all the parts of creation together
decisions.reason: The verbs begin with "with" (syn-). The most natural sense is that the whole creation groans as one; Paul adds "we too" only in verse 23.

decisions.choice: like a woman giving birth to a baby
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the picture of birth pains (m1).

source.text: οὐ μόνον δέ, ἀλλὰ καὶ αὐτοὶ τὴν ἀπαρχὴν τοῦ πνεύματος ἔχοντες ἡμεῖς καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς στενάζομεν, υἱοθεσίαν ἀπεκδεχόμενοι τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν τοῦ σώματος ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Not only and, but even ourselves the firstfruit of the Spirit having, we also ourselves in ourselves groan, adoption as sons awaiting, the redemption of the body of us.

en.L: And not only [that], but even we ourselves, having the firstfruits of the Spirit, we also groan within ourselves, eagerly awaiting adoption as {{gender:children|sons}}, the redemption of our body.
en.B: And not creation alone. We ourselves, who have the Spirit as the first share of the harvest, also groan within ourselves while we long for our adoption as {{gender:children|sons}}, when our body will be redeemed.
en.R: And we groan too. God has given us the Spirit as the first part of all that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give us. But we still groan inside, because we are waiting for our full adoption as {{gender:children|sons}}: the day when God will set our bodies free.

es.L: Y no solo [eso], sino que incluso nosotros, los que tenemos las primicias del Espíritu, también gemimos en nuestro interior, esperando ansiosamente [la] adopción como hijos, la redención de nuestro cuerpo.
es.B: Y no solo la creación. Nosotros mismos, que tenemos el Espíritu como la primera parte de la cosecha, también gemimos por dentro mientras anhelamos nuestra adopción como hijos, cuando nuestro cuerpo será redimido.
es.R: Y nosotros también gemimos. Dios nos ha dado el Espíritu como la primera parte de todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos dará. Pero todavía gemimos por dentro, porque esperamos nuestra adopción completa como hijos: el día en que Dios hará libres nuestros cuerpos.

fr.L: Et non seulement [elle], mais nous-mêmes aussi, qui avons les prémices de l’Esprit, nous aussi nous gémissons en nous-mêmes, attendant ardemment l’adoption comme {{gender:enfants|fils}}, la rédemption de notre corps.
fr.B: Et ce n’est pas seulement la création. Nous-mêmes, qui avons l’Esprit comme première part de la récolte, nous gémissons aussi au-dedans de nous, tandis que nous attendons avec ardeur notre adoption comme {{gender:enfants|fils}}, le moment où notre corps sera racheté.
fr.R: Et nous aussi, nous gémissons. Dieu nous a donné l’Esprit comme la première part de tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous donnera. Mais nous gémissons encore au fond de nous, parce que nous attendons d’être pleinement adoptés comme {{gender:enfants|fils}} : le jour où Dieu libérera notre corps.

sw.L: Na si [uumbaji] tu, bali hata sisi wenyewe, tukiwa na malimbuko ya Roho, nasi pia tunaugua ndani yetu, tukisubiri kwa hamu kufanywa wana, yaani kukombolewa kwa mwili wetu.
sw.B: Wala si uumbaji peke yake. Sisi wenyewe, tulio na Roho kama sehemu ya kwanza ya mavuno, nasi tunaugua ndani yetu huku tukitamani kufanywa wana, mwili wetu utakapokombolewa.
sw.R: Nasi pia tunaugua. Mungu ametupa Roho kama sehemu ya kwanza ya yote atakayotupa. Lakini bado tunaugua ndani yetu, kwa sababu tunangoja kufanywa wana kikamilifu: siku ambayo Mungu ataiweka huru miili yetu.

decisions.choice: firstfruits: the first part of the harvest, a pledge of the rest
decisions.reason: Israel brought the first sheaf of the harvest to God (Leviticus 23:10). It was part of the crop and promised that the rest was coming. The Spirit is God's first gift of the life to come, and the promise of the rest.

decisions.choice: the firstfruits of the Spirit: the firstfruits that are the Spirit
alternatives: the first share of the Spirit, with more of the Spirit to come
decisions.reason: Paul does not mean a first portion of the Spirit; the Spirit himself is the first part of the harvest, as in 2 Corinthians 1:22 the Spirit is the down payment.

decisions.choice: adoption still awaited: the full and public act of adoption
alternatives: a different adoption from that of verse 15
decisions.reason: Believers have already received adoption (verse 15), but they wait for it to be completed, when the body is raised. Paul often speaks of salvation as given now and still to come.

decisions.choice: the redemption of our body: the body set free from death
decisions.reason: apolutrōsis is release, especially of a slave or captive at a price (3:24). Here it is the body's release from decay and death at the resurrection, not escape from the body.

decisions.choice: "adoption" stands in the text
alternatives: leaves out "adoption": "eagerly awaiting the redemption of our body"
decisions.reason: A few early manuscripts leave out the word for adoption, perhaps because verse 15 says believers already have it. Most manuscripts have it, and the SBLGNT keeps it. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: adoption as {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: As in verse 15: the inclusive default names everyone adopted, and the traditional setting keeps "sons".

decisions.choice: the first share of the harvest (B); the first part of all that he will give us (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain the picture of the firstfruits (m1).

decisions.choice: our full adoption
decisions.reason: Readable adds "full" because believers have already been adopted (m3).

source.text: τῇ γὰρ ἐλπίδι ἐσώθημεν· ἐλπὶς δὲ βλεπομένη οὐκ ἔστιν ἐλπίς, ὃ γὰρ βλέπει τίς ἐλπίζει;

records.literal_gloss: In the for hope we were saved; hope but being seen not is hope, what for sees anyone does he hope?

en.L: For in hope we were saved. But hope being seen is not hope; for what anyone sees, who hopes [for it]?
en.B: It was in hope that we were saved. But a hope that is already in sight is no hope at all. Who goes on hoping for what is already in front of them?
en.R: God saved us, and so we have hope for what is still to come. If we can already see something, we do not need to hope for it. No one hopes for something that is already there.

es.L: Porque en esperanza fuimos salvados. Pero una esperanza que se ve no es esperanza; pues lo que uno ve, ¿quién [lo] espera?
es.B: Fue en esperanza como fuimos salvados. Pero una esperanza que ya está a la vista no es esperanza en absoluto. ¿Quién sigue esperando lo que ya tiene delante?
es.R: Dios nos salvó, y por eso tenemos esperanza en lo que todavía ha de venir. Si ya podemos ver algo, no necesitamos esperarlo. Nadie espera algo que ya está ahí.

fr.L: Car c’est en espérance que nous avons été sauvés. Or une espérance qu’on voit n’est pas une espérance ; car ce que quelqu’un voit, qui [l’]espère ?
fr.B: C’est dans l’espérance que nous avons été sauvés. Mais une espérance qu’on a déjà sous les yeux n’est plus une espérance. Qui continue d’espérer ce qu’il voit déjà devant lui ?
fr.R: Dieu nous a sauvés, et c’est pourquoi nous espérons ce qui doit encore venir. Si nous pouvons déjà voir une chose, nous n’avons pas besoin de l’espérer. Personne n’espère une chose qui est déjà là.

sw.L: Kwa maana tuliokolewa katika tumaini. Lakini tumaini linaloonekana si tumaini; kwa maana kile mtu anachokiona, nani anakitumainia?
sw.B: Ilikuwa katika tumaini kwamba tuliokolewa. Lakini tumaini ambalo tayari linaonekana si tumaini hata kidogo. Ni nani anayeendelea kutumainia kitu kilicho mbele yake tayari?
sw.R: Mungu alituokoa, na kwa hiyo tuna tumaini kwa ajili ya yale ambayo bado yanakuja. Ikiwa tayari tunaweza kukiona kitu, hatuhitaji kukitumainia. Hakuna mtu anayetumainia kitu ambacho tayari kipo.

decisions.choice: in hope we were saved: salvation came with a future still to be seen
alternatives: saved by hope, as if hope were the means
decisions.reason: Paul says that people are saved through faith (Ephesians 2:8), so the dative here is not the means. Salvation came to believers with hope attached: much of it is still to come.

decisions.choice: "who hopes for what he sees?"
alternatives: "why does anyone still hope for what he sees?"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ slightly in the question at the end of the verse. The sense is the same: no one hopes for what is already seen. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer "no one"
decisions.reason: Paul asks a question with an obvious answer. The levels keep the question at Literal and Balanced; Readable gives the answer.

decisions.choice: God saved us
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who saves.

decisions.choice: No one hopes for something that is already there
alternatives: who hopes for what he sees?
decisions.reason: Readable states the answer Paul's question expects (m3).

source.text: εἰ δὲ ὃ οὐ βλέπομεν ἐλπίζομεν, δι’ ὑπομονῆς ἀπεκδεχόμεθα.

records.literal_gloss: If but what not we see we hope for, through endurance we eagerly await.

en.L: But if we hope for what we do not see, we eagerly await [it] with endurance.
en.B: But if what we hope for is something we do not yet see, we keep waiting for it with endurance.
en.R: But we hope for things we cannot see yet. So we keep on waiting for them, and we do not give up.

es.L: Pero si lo que no vemos [es lo que] esperamos, con perseverancia [lo] aguardamos ansiosamente.
es.B: Pero si lo que esperamos es algo que todavía no vemos, seguimos aguardándolo con perseverancia.
es.R: Pero esperamos cosas que todavía no podemos ver. Así que seguimos esperándolas, y no nos rendimos.

fr.L: Mais si nous espérons ce que nous ne voyons pas, nous [l’]attendons ardemment avec endurance.
fr.B: Mais si ce que nous espérons est une chose que nous ne voyons pas encore, nous continuons à l’attendre avec endurance.
fr.R: Mais nous espérons des choses que nous ne pouvons pas encore voir. Alors nous continuons à les attendre, et nous ne nous décourageons pas.

sw.L: Lakini ikiwa tunatumainia kile tusichokiona, tunakingoja kwa hamu kwa uvumilivu.
sw.B: Lakini ikiwa tunachotumainia ni kitu ambacho bado hatukioni, tunaendelea kukingoja kwa uvumilivu.
sw.R: Lakini tunatumainia mambo ambayo bado hatuwezi kuyaona. Kwa hiyo tunaendelea kuyangoja, wala hatukati tamaa.

decisions.choice: endurance: holding out under pressure
decisions.reason: hupomonē is the steady endurance of someone under strain, the word of 5:3-4. Waiting for what is not yet seen takes it.

decisions.choice: eagerly await: wait with longing for what is sure to come
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verses 19 and 23: creation and believers wait for the same thing.

decisions.choice: we do not give up
decisions.reason: Readable says what endurance means in plain words (m1).

source.text: Ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα συναντιλαμβάνεται τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ ἡμῶν· τὸ γὰρ τί προσευξώμεθα καθὸ δεῖ οὐκ οἴδαμεν, ἀλλὰ αὐτὸ τὸ πνεῦμα ὑπερεντυγχάνει στεναγμοῖς ἀλαλήτοις, ὁ δὲ ἐραυνῶν τὰς καρδίας οἶδεν τί τὸ φρόνημα τοῦ πνεύματος, ὅτι κατὰ θεὸν ἐντυγχάνει ὑπὲρ ἁγίων.

records.literal_gloss: Likewise and also the Spirit helps with the weakness of us; the for what we should pray as is necessary not we know, but itself the Spirit intercedes on behalf with groanings unspoken; \v 27 the [one] and searching the hearts knows what [is] the mindset of the Spirit, that according to God he intercedes on behalf of holy [ones].

en.L: And likewise the Spirit also takes hold with [us] in our weakness; for what we should pray, as is fitting, we do not know, but the Spirit {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} intercedes on [our] behalf with unspoken groanings. \v 27 And the one who searches the hearts knows what the mindset of the Spirit [is], because [the Spirit] intercedes for [the] holy ones according to God.
en.B: In the same way, the Spirit also lends a hand in our weakness. What we should pray for, and how, we do not know. But the Spirit {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} pleads on our behalf, with groans that no words carry. \v 27 And God, who looks deep into hearts, knows what the Spirit intends, because the Spirit pleads for God's holy people in line with what God wants.
en.R: In the same way, the Spirit helps us when we are weak. We do not know what we should pray for, or how to pray. But the Spirit {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} prays to God for us. The Spirit groans in ways that words cannot say. \v 27 God sees what is in our hearts, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} knows what the Spirit is thinking. The Spirit prays for God's people in the way God wants.

es.L: Y así también el Espíritu se suma a ayudar[nos] en nuestra debilidad; porque no sabemos qué pedir en oración como es debido, pero el Espíritu mismo intercede [por nosotros] con gemidos no expresados en palabras. \v 27 Y el que examina los corazones conoce la mentalidad del Espíritu, porque [el Espíritu] intercede según Dios en favor de [los] santos.
es.B: Del mismo modo, también el Espíritu nos echa una mano en nuestra debilidad. No sabemos qué pedir ni cómo pedirlo. Pero el Espíritu mismo ruega a nuestro favor, con gemidos que ninguna palabra puede expresar. \v 27 Y Dios, que mira en lo profundo de los corazones, sabe lo que el Espíritu se propone, porque el Espíritu ruega por el pueblo santo de Dios de acuerdo con lo que Dios quiere.
es.R: De la misma manera, el Espíritu nos ayuda cuando somos débiles. No sabemos qué debemos pedir en oración, ni cómo orar. Pero el Espíritu mismo ora a Dios por nosotros. El Espíritu gime de maneras que las palabras no pueden decir. \v 27 Dios ve lo que hay en nuestros corazones, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sabe lo que el Espíritu está pensando. El Espíritu ora por el pueblo de Dios de la manera que Dios quiere.

fr.L: Et de même l’Esprit aussi vient en aide à notre faiblesse ; car ce que nous devons demander dans la prière comme il faut, nous ne le savons pas, mais l’Esprit {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} intercède [pour nous] par des gémissements inexprimés. \v 27 Et celui qui scrute les cœurs sait quelle [est] la pensée de l’Esprit, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} intercède pour les saints selon Dieu.
fr.B: De la même manière, l’Esprit aussi nous prête main-forte dans notre faiblesse. Nous ne savons pas ce que nous devons demander dans nos prières, ni comment le demander. Mais l’Esprit {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} plaide en notre faveur, par des gémissements qu’aucune parole ne peut porter. \v 27 Et Dieu, qui sonde le fond des cœurs, connaît les intentions de l’Esprit, car l’Esprit plaide pour le peuple saint de Dieu comme Dieu le veut.
fr.R: De la même façon, l’Esprit nous aide quand nous sommes faibles. Nous ne savons pas ce que nous devons demander quand nous prions, ni comment prier. Mais l’Esprit {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} prie Dieu pour nous. L’Esprit gémit d’une manière que les mots ne peuvent pas dire. \v 27 Dieu voit ce qu’il y a dans nos cœurs, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sait ce que pense l’Esprit. L’Esprit prie pour le peuple de Dieu comme Dieu le veut.

sw.L: Na vivyo hivyo Roho pia anashiriki kutusaidia katika udhaifu wetu; kwa maana hatujui tuombe nini ipasavyo, lakini Roho {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} anaomba [kwa ajili yetu] kwa kuugua kusiko na maneno. \v 27 Naye yule anayeichunguza mioyo anajua fikira za Roho ni zipi, kwa sababu [Roho] anawaombea watakatifu kwa kadiri ya Mungu.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo, Roho naye anatushika mkono katika udhaifu wetu. Hatujui tuombe nini, wala jinsi ya kuomba. Lakini Roho {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} anaomba kwa niaba yetu, kwa kuugua ambako maneno hayawezi kubeba. \v 27 Naye Mungu, anayetazama ndani kabisa ya mioyo, anajua kile Roho anachokusudia, kwa sababu Roho anawaombea watu watakatifu wa Mungu kulingana na mapenzi ya Mungu.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, Roho anatusaidia tunapokuwa dhaifu. Hatujui tunapaswa kuomba nini, wala jinsi ya kuomba. Lakini Roho {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} anamwomba Mungu kwa ajili yetu. Roho anaugua kwa namna ambayo maneno hayawezi kueleza. \v 27 Mungu anaona yaliyo ndani ya mioyo yetu, naye anajua kile Roho anachofikiri. Roho anawaombea watu wa Mungu kwa namna ambayo Mungu anataka.

decisions.choice: likewise: as hope sustains us, so the Spirit helps us
decisions.reason: Paul has said that hope keeps believers waiting (verses 24-25). In the same way the Spirit helps them while they wait and groan (verse 23).

decisions.choice: helps: takes hold of a load together with someone
decisions.reason: sunantilambanomai pictures someone taking the other end of a heavy load, as Martha wanted Mary to help her (Luke 10:40). The Spirit does not take the weakness away; he shares the weight.

decisions.choice: what we should pray, as we ought: both what to ask and how
decisions.reason: The phrase "as is fitting" follows the question of what to pray. Believers do not know what to ask in a way that fits God's will, or how to ask it.

decisions.choice: unspoken groanings: groans that are never put into words
alternatives: groanings too deep to be put into words
decisions.reason: alalētos can mean "not spoken" or "that cannot be spoken". Either way the Spirit's pleading goes beyond words. The word does not describe speaking in tongues, which uses words of a kind.

decisions.choice: intercedes, without "for us"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "for us" after the verb; the earliest leave it out, and the SBLGNT follows them. The verb itself already means pleading on someone's behalf, so the sense is the same. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: the one who searches the hearts: God
decisions.reason: The Old Testament speaks of God as the one who sees and tests the heart (1 Samuel 16:7; Psalm 139:1; Jeremiah 17:10). Paul uses that description here.

decisions.choice: because: God knows the Spirit's mind because the Spirit prays as God wills
alternatives: "that": God knows that the Spirit prays as he wills
decisions.reason: hoti can give the reason or the content of what God knows. The sense is close either way: the Spirit's prayer and God's will agree.

decisions.choice: according to God: in keeping with God's will
decisions.reason: The short phrase means "as God wants", as in 2 Corinthians 7:9-11 ("grief according to God").

decisions.choice: holy ones: God's people, set apart for him
decisions.reason: hagioi are all believers, called to be holy (1:7), not a few outstanding ones.

decisions.choice: the Spirit {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}; "the Spirit" repeated
decisions.reason: The Greek pronouns are neuter only because the word for spirit is neuter. English repeats "the Spirit" where it would need a pronoun, and says "the Spirit himself", never "it".

decisions.choice: God, who looks deep into hearts (B); God sees what is in our hearts (R)
alternatives: the one who searches the hearts
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God, whom the phrase describes (m6).

decisions.choice: el Espíritu mismo, no setting; "el Espíritu" repeated
decisions.reason: As in verse 16, the Spirit is "el Espíritu mismo", and where the Greek has only a verb in verse 27 Spanish names the Spirit again rather than use a pronoun, as the English does. "Él" in the Readable of verse 27 is God and takes the deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} intercède
decisions.reason: English Literal supplies "[the Spirit]" because an English "it" or "he" would be unclear. French "il" points back to "l’Esprit" naturally, since the noun is masculine, so Literal writes the pronoun with the deity_pronoun span and needs no bracket.

decisions.choice: les saints (L); le peuple saint de Dieu (B); le peuple de Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for Paul's letters: Literal keeps the traditional word, and Balanced and Readable say who they are, God's people set apart for him (m9), since "les saints" today suggests canonised individuals.

decisions.choice: fikira za Roho
decisions.reason: The word for the Spirit's mind is the one rendered "fikira" in verses 6-7 ("fikira za mwili", "fikira za Roho"), so Literal keeps it here. In Balanced and Readable "naye" (and he) carries the pronoun for God inside the word, so it takes no span.

source.text: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσι τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν, τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν.

records.literal_gloss: We know and that to the [ones] loving the God all things work together for good, to the [ones] according to purpose called being.

en.L: And we know that to those who love God all things work together for good, to those who are called according to [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] purpose.
en.B: We know that, for people who love God, all things work together and lead to good. They are the ones called in keeping with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} purpose.
en.R: We know that in the lives of those who love God, all things work together to bring about good. These are the people God has called, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planned.

es.L: Y sabemos que a quienes aman a Dios todas las cosas cooperan para bien, a quienes son llamados según [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] propósito.
es.B: Sabemos que, para quienes aman a Dios, todas las cosas actúan juntas y conducen al bien. Son los que Dios ha llamado según lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se propuso.
es.R: Sabemos que, en la vida de los que aman a Dios, todas las cosas obran juntas para producir el bien. Son las personas a quienes Dios ha llamado, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo había planeado.

fr.L: Et nous savons que, pour ceux qui aiment Dieu, toutes choses travaillent ensemble pour le bien, pour ceux qui sont appelés selon [{{deity_pronoun:son|Son}}] dessein.
fr.B: Nous savons que, pour ceux qui aiment Dieu, tout agit ensemble et conduit au bien. Ce sont ceux qui sont appelés conformément à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} dessein.
fr.R: Nous savons que, dans la vie de ceux qui aiment Dieu, toutes choses agissent ensemble pour produire le bien. Ce sont les gens que Dieu a appelés, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait prévu.

sw.L: Na tunajua kwamba kwa wale wanaompenda Mungu mambo yote hushirikiana kwa ajili ya mema, kwa wale walioitwa kulingana na kusudi [{{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}].
sw.B: Tunajua kwamba, kwa watu wanaompenda Mungu, mambo yote yanashirikiana na kuelekea kwenye mema. Hao ndio wale walioitwa kulingana na kusudi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Tunajua kwamba katika maisha ya wale wanaompenda Mungu, mambo yote yanashirikiana kuleta mema. Hao ni watu ambao Mungu amewaita, kama alivyopanga.

decisions.choice: no word "God" as the subject of "works together"
alternatives: "God works all things together for good"
decisions.reason: Some early and important manuscripts add "God" after the verb, so that God is the subject: "God works all things together for good". Most manuscripts do not have it, and the SBLGNT leaves it out. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: "all things" is the subject: all things work together for good
alternatives: God is the unnamed subject: "he works in all things for good"
the Spirit of verses 26-27 is the subject
decisions.reason: In the text without "God", "all things" most naturally serves as the subject. Some take God, or the Spirit just mentioned, as the subject and "all things" as what he works in. On every reading, the good comes about because of God and his purpose, named in the same verse; things do not work for good by themselves.

decisions.choice: good: the good God intends, which verse 29 names
alternatives: comfort or success in this life
decisions.reason: The good is not that everything turns out pleasantly. Verses 29-30 say what it is: being made like God's Son and sharing his glory, even through the sufferings of verses 17-18 and 35-36.

decisions.choice: according to purpose: God's purpose
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "according to purpose", but the calling is God's (verse 30), so the purpose is his, as in 9:11.

decisions.choice: the called: those who love God are those God called
decisions.reason: The second phrase describes the same people as the first, from God's side: they love God because he called them.

decisions.choice: [his] purpose (L); his purpose, as he planned (B, R)
decisions.reason: English needs to say whose purpose it is (m4); Literal brackets the word the Greek lacks.

decisions.choice: todas las cosas cooperan (L); actúan juntas (B); obran juntas (R)
alternatives: todas las cosas les ayudan a bien
decisions.reason: The text has no word "God" as subject (m1), and "all things" is the subject of the verb (m2), so every level keeps "todas las cosas" as the subject, rather than the familiar wording with God as the one who arranges them. God's purpose stays in the second half (m3, m4).

decisions.choice: travaillent ensemble (L); agit ensemble (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is "work together", with "all things" as its subject (m2). Literal and Balanced say both parts of it; "concourir" is shorter but hides the "together" and is the wording of familiar versions.

decisions.choice: mambo yote hushirikiana (L); yanashirikiana (B, R)
decisions.reason: "All things" is the subject (m1, m2), so every level keeps "mambo yote" as the subject. "Kushirikiana" (to work together, cooperate) is one verb for the Greek compound. Readable has no span where the English has "he planned": the subject is in the verb ("alivyopanga").

source.text: ὅτι οὓς προέγνω, καὶ προώρισεν συμμόρφους τῆς εἰκόνος τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ, εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν πρωτότοκον ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς·

records.literal_gloss: Because whom he foreknew, also he predestined conformed of the image of the Son of him, for the to be him firstborn among many brothers;

en.L: Because those whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} foreknew, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also predestined [to be] conformed to the image of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son, for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be firstborn among many {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}.
en.B: Those God knew beforehand {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also marked out beforehand to be shaped into the image of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son, so that the Son would be the firstborn among many {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}.
en.R: Long before, God already knew those who would be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}. He decided then that they would be made just like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son. So the Son would be the first and most honored among many {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}.

es.L: Porque a los que conoció de antemano, también los predestinó [a ser] configurados según la imagen de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo, a fin de que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} fuera primogénito en medio de muchos hermanos.
es.B: A los que Dios conoció de antemano, también los destinó de antemano a ser formados a imagen de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo, para que el Hijo fuera el primogénito en medio de muchos hermanos.
es.R: Desde mucho antes, Dios ya conocía a los que serían {{deity_pronoun:suyos|Suyos}}. Decidió entonces que llegarían a ser como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo. Así el Hijo sería el primero y el de más honor entre muchos hermanos.

fr.L: Car ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a connus d’avance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi prédestinés [à être] conformes à l’image de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils, pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit le premier-né parmi beaucoup de {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}.
fr.B: Ceux que Dieu a connus d’avance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi destinés d’avance à être façonnés à l’image de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils, afin que le Fils soit le premier-né d’un grand nombre de {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}.
fr.R: Il y a très longtemps, Dieu connaissait déjà ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiendraient. Il a décidé alors qu’ils deviendraient tout à fait semblables à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils. Ainsi, le Fils serait le premier et le plus honoré d’un grand nombre de {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana wale aliowajua kabla, aliwaamulia pia tangu awali [wawe] wenye kufanana na sura ya Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, ili {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} apate kuwa mzaliwa wa kwanza kati ya ndugu wengi.
sw.B: Wale ambao Mungu aliwajua tangu awali, aliwatenga pia tangu awali wafanywe kuwa na sura ya Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, ili Mwana awe mzaliwa wa kwanza kati ya ndugu wengi.
sw.R: Zamani sana, Mungu alikuwa tayari anawajua wale ambao wangekuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Aliamua wakati huo kwamba watafanywa kufanana kabisa na Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Hivyo Mwana angekuwa wa kwanza na mwenye heshima kuu kati ya ndugu wengi.

decisions.choice: foreknew: knew and chose beforehand, in a relationship
alternatives: knew in advance what people would do
decisions.reason: In the Bible God's "knowing" people often means choosing them and setting his love on them (Amos 3:2). Paul uses the same verb of Israel in 11:2, "his people whom he foreknew".

decisions.choice: predestined: decided beforehand, marked out in advance
decisions.reason: proorizō is to set a boundary or decide something ahead of time. Here God decides beforehand what those he knew will become: like his Son.

decisions.choice: conformed to the image of his Son: sharing the Son's form and glory
decisions.reason: The phrase includes the change of character that begins now (2 Corinthians 3:18) and the glorified body to come (Philippians 3:21, the same word). Humans were made in God's image (Genesis 1:27); the Son is that image (2 Corinthians 4:4).

decisions.choice: firstborn: first in time and first in rank
decisions.reason: The firstborn had the place of honor and the double share (Psalm 89:28 in Hebrew numbering, of the king). Christ is also the first to rise from the dead (Colossians 1:18), and others will follow him.

decisions.choice: brothers: the members of God's family, women and men
decisions.reason: Those conformed to the Son become his brothers and sisters, God's family.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The inclusive default names the whole family (m5); the traditional setting keeps "brothers".

decisions.choice: knew beforehand, marked out beforehand (B); decided then (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say in plain words what the two verbs mean (m1, m2). Literal keeps the traditional words.

decisions.choice: the first and most honored
decisions.reason: Readable explains what "firstborn" means here (m4).

decisions.choice: conoció de antemano, predestinó (L); conoció de antemano, destinó de antemano (B)
decisions.reason: As in 11:2 ("conoció de antemano") and Ephesians 1:5 ("predestinado" at Literal, "de antemano nos destinó" at Balanced). Balanced repeats "de antemano" so the two verbs are heard as a pair, as the English Balanced does with "beforehand". "Hermanos" has no gender setting (see verse 12).

decisions.choice: ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiendraient
decisions.reason: The English "those who would be his" carries the span on "his". French "les siens" would put it on a word whose capitalised form reads oddly, so Readable says "those who would belong to him" with the span on "lui".

decisions.choice: aliowajua kabla, aliwaamulia tangu awali (L); aliwajua tangu awali, aliwatenga tangu awali (B)
alternatives: aliowajua tangu asili, aliwachagua tangu asili
decisions.reason: As in 11:2 ("aliowajua kabla", "aliowajua tangu awali") and Ephesians 1:5 ("kutuamulia tangu awali" at Literal, "alitutenga tangu awali" at Balanced). Balanced repeats "tangu awali" so the two verbs are heard as a pair. "Ndugu" has no gender setting (see verse 12).

source.text: οὓς δὲ προώρισεν, τούτους καὶ ἐκάλεσεν· καὶ οὓς ἐκάλεσεν, τούτους καὶ ἐδικαίωσεν· οὓς δὲ ἐδικαίωσεν, τούτους καὶ ἐδόξασεν.

records.literal_gloss: Whom and he predestined, these also he called; and whom he called, these also he justified; whom and he justified, these also he glorified.

en.L: And those whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} predestined, these {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also called; and those whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called, these {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also justified; and those whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} justified, these {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also glorified.
en.B: And those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} marked out beforehand, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also called. Those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also declared righteous. And those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} declared righteous, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also glorified.
en.R: Those God decided on ahead of time, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also called. Those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also put right with {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. And those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put right with {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also gave a share in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.

es.L: Y a quienes predestinó, a esos también los llamó; y a quienes llamó, a esos también los justificó; y a quienes justificó, a esos también los glorificó.
es.B: Y a quienes destinó de antemano, también los llamó. A quienes llamó, también los justificó. Y a quienes justificó, también los glorificó.
es.R: A quienes Dios había señalado de antemano, también los llamó. A quienes llamó, también los declaró justos. Y a quienes declaró justos, también les dio parte en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.

fr.L: Et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prédestinés, ceux-là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi appelés ; et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a appelés, ceux-là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi justifiés ; et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a justifiés, ceux-là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi glorifiés.
fr.B: Et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a destinés d’avance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi appelés. Ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a appelés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi déclarés justes. Et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déclarés justes, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi glorifiés.
fr.R: Ceux que Dieu avait choisis à l’avance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi appelés. Ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a appelés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi mis en règle avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis en règle avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a aussi donné une part de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.

sw.L: Na wale aliowaamulia tangu awali, hao pia aliwaita; na wale aliowaita, hao pia aliwahesabia haki; na wale aliowahesabia haki, hao pia aliwatukuza.
sw.B: Na wale aliowatenga tangu awali, aliwaita pia. Wale aliowaita, aliwahesabia haki pia. Na wale aliowahesabia haki, aliwatukuza pia.
sw.R: Wale ambao Mungu aliamua juu yao tangu awali, aliwaita pia. Wale aliowaita, aliwahesabia haki, akawaweka katika uhusiano mwema naye. Na wale aliowahesabia haki, aliwapa pia sehemu katika utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

decisions.choice: called: God's call that brings people to himself
alternatives: an invitation that may be refused
decisions.reason: In Paul "called" means God's effective call through the gospel, which brings people to faith (1:6-7, 9:24; 1 Corinthians 1:24).

decisions.choice: justified: declared righteous by God
decisions.reason: dikaioō is the verb of 3:24-26 and 5:1: God declares the ungodly righteous through faith in Christ (4:5).

decisions.choice: glorified: a future glory spoken of as already done
decisions.reason: Glory is still to be revealed (verses 17-18, 21). Paul uses the past tense because, in God's purpose, it is as certain as the calling and justifying that have already happened.

decisions.choice: declared righteous
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "justify" means (m2), as elsewhere in Romans.

decisions.choice: put right with himself; gave a share in his glory
decisions.reason: Readable says "put right with himself" for justify, as in 3:24-26, and explains "glorified" as being given a share in God's glory (m3).

decisions.choice: justificó (L, B); declaró justos (R)
decisions.reason: As settled at 2:13 and used in 3:24-30 and 4:2, Literal and Balanced keep "justificar", and Readable says "declarar justo", the verdict the word describes (m2). The same holds in verse 33. Spanish marks God only in the verbs here, so it has no deity_pronoun spans where the English has "he".

decisions.choice: justifier (L); déclarer juste (B); mettre en règle avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} (R), also in 8:33
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets: Literal keeps the traditional word, Balanced says what it means, God's verdict that declares righteous (m2), and Readable follows the English "put right with himself". "Rendre juste" would suggest a change of character rather than a verdict.

decisions.choice: aliwahesabia haki (every level; R adds akawaweka katika uhusiano mwema naye)
decisions.reason: "Kuhesabiwa haki" is the settled phrase for this verb in Romans and is kept at every level, here and in verse 33; Readable adds what it means, in the words of 4:1 R, where the English Readable says "put right with himself". The past tense of "glorified" is kept, as the meaning decision explains (m3).

source.text: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν πρὸς ταῦτα;

records.literal_gloss: What then will we say to these [things]?

en.L: What then will we say to these things?
en.B: So what is our response to all this?
en.R: So what can we say about all this?

es.L: ¿Qué diremos entonces frente a estas cosas?
es.B: Entonces, ¿cuál es nuestra respuesta a todo esto?
es.R: Entonces, ¿qué podemos decir de todo esto?

fr.L: Que dirons-nous donc devant ces choses ?
fr.B: Que répondre donc à tout cela ?
fr.R: Alors, que pouvons-nous dire de tout cela ?

sw.L: Basi tutasema nini kwa mambo haya?
sw.B: Basi, tujibu nini kuhusu haya yote?
sw.R: Basi tunaweza kusema nini kuhusu mambo haya yote?

decisions.choice: these things: everything Paul has said, especially in chapter 8
decisions.reason: Paul often asks "What then will we say?" to draw a conclusion (4:1, 6:1). Here he answers with the questions of verses 31-35.

source.text: εἰ ὁ θεὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν, τίς καθ’ ἡμῶν;

records.literal_gloss: If the God for us, who against us?

en.L: If God [is] for us, who [is] against us?
en.B: If God is on our side, who can stand against us?
en.R: If God is on our side, no one can win against us.

es.L: Si Dios [está] a favor de nosotros, ¿quién [estará] contra nosotros?
es.B: Si Dios está de nuestro lado, ¿quién puede hacernos frente?
es.R: Si Dios está de nuestro lado, nadie puede vencernos.

fr.L: Si Dieu [est] pour nous, qui [est] contre nous ?
fr.B: Si Dieu est de notre côté, qui pourra tenir contre nous ?
fr.R: Si Dieu est de notre côté, personne ne peut nous vaincre.

sw.L: Ikiwa Mungu [yuko] kwa ajili yetu, ni nani [aliye] dhidi yetu?
sw.B: Ikiwa Mungu yuko upande wetu, ni nani anayeweza kusimama dhidi yetu?
sw.R: Ikiwa Mungu yuko upande wetu, hakuna mtu anayeweza kutushinda.

decisions.choice: if: since God is for us
alternatives: a real doubt whether God is for us
decisions.reason: Paul states a condition he holds to be true, as verse 32 shows.

decisions.choice: who is against us: no one who can prevail
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "no one". Believers do have enemies (verses 35-36), but none who can stand against God.

decisions.choice: no one can win against us
decisions.reason: Readable states the answer the question expects (m2).

source.text: ὅς γε τοῦ ἰδίου υἱοῦ οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν πάντων παρέδωκεν αὐτόν, πῶς οὐχὶ καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ἡμῖν χαρίσεται;

records.literal_gloss: Who indeed the own Son not spared, but for us all handed over him, how not also with him the all things to us will he freely give?

en.L: He who indeed did not spare {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Son but handed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over for us all, how will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not also with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} freely give us all things?
en.B: God did not hold back even {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Son, but handed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over for us all. How could {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fail, then, to give us everything along with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as a free gift?
en.R: God did not keep back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Son. He gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} up to die for all of us. So we can be sure that God will also give us everything else, along with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son.

es.L: Aquel que de hecho no se reservó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Hijo, sino que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entregó a favor de todos nosotros, ¿cómo no va a darnos también gratuitamente, junto con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, todas las cosas?
es.B: Dios no se guardó ni siquiera a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Hijo, sino que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entregó por todos nosotros. ¿Cómo podría, entonces, dejar de darnos con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todo lo demás como un regalo?
es.R: Dios no se quedó con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Hijo. Lo entregó para que muriera por todos nosotros. Así que podemos estar seguros de que Dios también nos dará todo lo demás, junto con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo.

fr.L: Celui qui, justement, n’a pas épargné {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Fils mais {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a livré pour nous tous, comment, avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, ne nous accordera-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pas aussi toutes choses par grâce ?
fr.B: Dieu n’a pas même retenu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Fils, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a livré pour nous tous. Comment pourrait-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donc ne pas nous donner aussi tout le reste avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, comme un don gratuit ?
fr.R: Dieu n’a pas gardé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Fils pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a donné pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} meure pour nous tous. Alors nous pouvons être sûrs que Dieu nous donnera aussi tout le reste, avec {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils.

sw.L: Yeye ambaye hakumzuilia hata Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe, bali alimkabidhi kwa ajili yetu sote, je, hatatupa pia bure vitu vyote pamoja na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}?
sw.B: Mungu hakumzuilia hata Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe, bali alimkabidhi kwa ajili yetu sote. Basi angewezaje kukosa kutupa kila kitu pamoja naye kama zawadi ya bure?
sw.R: Mungu hakumzuilia Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. Alimtoa afe kwa ajili yetu sote. Kwa hiyo tunaweza kuwa na uhakika kwamba Mungu atatupa pia kila kitu kingine, pamoja na Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

decisions.choice: did not spare his own Son: as Abraham did not withhold Isaac
decisions.reason: In the Greek Old Testament the angel says to Abraham, "you did not spare your beloved son" (Genesis 22:12, 16), with the same verb. What Abraham was spared, God did.

decisions.choice: handed over: gave up to death
decisions.reason: paradidōmi is the verb of 4:25, "handed over because of our trespasses", and of the passion accounts. God gave his Son over to die.

decisions.choice: freely give: give as an act of grace
decisions.reason: charizomai is to give freely, from the same root as grace. If God gave the greatest gift, he will give the rest.

decisions.choice: a question expecting "he certainly will"
decisions.reason: Paul argues from the greater to the lesser: the question means that God will certainly give believers everything with his Son.

decisions.choice: gave him up to die
decisions.reason: Readable says what "handed over" means (m2).

decisions.choice: So we can be sure that God will also give us everything
alternatives: how will he not also give us all things?
decisions.reason: Readable states the answer the question expects (m4).

decisions.choice: no se reservó (L); no se guardó (B); nos dará gratuitamente (L); como un regalo (B)
decisions.reason: To "spare" here is to hold back for oneself, as Abraham did not withhold Isaac (m1). "No se reservó" and "no se guardó" say that plainly, where "no perdonó" would be heard as "did not forgive". The giving is an act of grace (m3), so Literal adds "gratuitamente" and Balanced "como un regalo".

decisions.choice: hakumzuilia (did not withhold); alimkabidhi (handed over)
decisions.reason: "Kuzuilia" is to keep something back from someone, which is the sense of "not spare" (m1). "Kukabidhi" is to hand a person over to others, the sense of the verb (m2); Readable says plainly that he gave him up to die. "Mwana wake mwenyewe" (his own Son): "mwenyewe" goes with the Son here and takes no span.

source.text: τίς ἐγκαλέσει κατὰ ἐκλεκτῶν θεοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: Who will bring a charge against chosen [ones] of God?

en.L: Who will bring a charge against [the] chosen ones of God?
en.B: Who will bring any accusation against those God has chosen?
en.R: Who can accuse the people God has chosen?

es.L: ¿Quién presentará acusación contra [los] elegidos de Dios?
es.B: ¿Quién va a acusar de algo a los que Dios ha elegido?
es.R: ¿Quién puede acusar a las personas que Dios ha elegido?

fr.L: Qui portera une accusation contre les élus de Dieu ?
fr.B: Qui portera la moindre accusation contre ceux que Dieu a choisis ?
fr.R: Qui peut accuser les gens que Dieu a choisis ?

sw.L: Ni nani atakayeleta mashtaka dhidi ya wateule wa Mungu?
sw.B: Ni nani atakayeleta shtaka lolote dhidi ya wale ambao Mungu amewachagua?
sw.R: Ni nani anayeweza kuwashtaki watu ambao Mungu amewachagua?

decisions.choice: bring a charge: accuse in court
decisions.reason: enkaleō is a law-court word: to bring a formal charge. Paul pictures the final judgment.

decisions.choice: chosen ones: those God has chosen for himself
decisions.reason: eklektoi is the Old Testament name for God's people (Isaiah 65:9). It sums up verses 29-30.

decisions.choice: a question, answered by the next sentence
decisions.reason: Verses 33-35 are a series of questions. The SBLGNT reads the words after each question as Paul's answer.

source.text: θεὸς ὁ δικαιῶν·

records.literal_gloss: God the [one] justifying;

en.L: God [is] the one who justifies.
en.B: God is the one who declares them righteous.
en.R: It is God who puts them right with {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}.

es.L: Dios [es] quien justifica.
es.B: Dios es quien los justifica.
es.R: Es Dios quien los declara justos.

fr.L: Dieu [est] celui qui justifie.
fr.B: Dieu est celui qui les déclare justes.
fr.R: C’est Dieu qui les met en règle avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Mungu [ni] yule anayehesabia haki.
sw.B: Ni Mungu anayewahesabia haki.
sw.R: Mungu ndiye anayewahesabia haki na kuwaweka katika uhusiano mwema naye.

decisions.choice: a statement: God is the one who justifies
alternatives: a question: "Will God, who justifies, bring a charge?"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT punctuates these words as an answer. Some read them as a further question expecting "no". Either way, the judge who declares believers righteous will not accuse them (Isaiah 50:8-9, which this passage echoes).

decisions.choice: God who justifies: an echo of Isaiah 50:8
decisions.reason: The servant of the LORD says, "He who vindicates me is near; who will contend with me?" Paul uses the same law-court picture.

decisions.choice: declares them righteous
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "justify" means, as in verse 30; it supplies "them", the chosen ones.

decisions.choice: puts them right with himself
decisions.reason: Readable uses the wording of verse 30.

source.text: τίς ὁ κατακρινῶν;

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] the [one] condemning?

en.L: Who [is] the one who will condemn?
en.B: Who is going to condemn them?
en.R: Who will say they are guilty and must be punished?

es.L: ¿Quién [es] el que va a condenar?
es.B: ¿Quién va a condenarlos?
es.R: ¿Quién dirá que son culpables y que deben ser castigados?

fr.L: Qui [est] celui qui condamnera ?
fr.B: Qui va les condamner ?
fr.R: Qui dira qu’ils sont coupables et qu’ils doivent être punis ?

sw.L: Nani [ndiye] atakayewatia hatiani?
sw.B: Ni nani atakayewatia hatiani?
sw.R: Ni nani atakayesema kwamba wana hatia na lazima waadhibiwe?

decisions.choice: the one who will condemn: future
decisions.reason: The same letters can be read as a present or a future participle; the SBLGNT accents it as future, looking to the last judgment.

decisions.choice: say they are guilty and must be punished
decisions.reason: Readable says what "condemn" means, as in verse 1.

decisions.choice: kuwatia hatiani
decisions.reason: "Kuhukumu" is to judge, which may end in acquittal; the verb here is the verdict of guilty and its sentence, the noun of verse 1 (m1). "Kutia hatiani" (to find guilty) says that, and Readable spells out guilt and punishment as the English Readable does.

source.text: Χριστὸς ὁ ἀποθανών, μᾶλλον δὲ ἐγερθείς, ὅς καί ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θεοῦ, ὃς καὶ ἐντυγχάνει ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν·

records.literal_gloss: Christ the [one] having died, rather and having been raised, who also is at right hand of the God, who also intercedes for us;

en.L: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} [is] the one who died, and more than that, was raised, who also is at [the] right hand of God, who also intercedes for us.
en.B: {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} is the one who died; still more, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was raised, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is at the right hand of God, where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pleads on our behalf.
en.R: {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} died, and more than that, God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to life. Now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has the place of honor at God's right side, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} speaks to God for us.

es.L: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} [es] quien murió, y aún más, quien fue resucitado, quien también está a [la] derecha de Dios, quien además ruega por nosotros.
es.B: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} es quien murió; más todavía, fue resucitado, y está a la derecha de Dios, donde ruega a nuestro favor.
es.R: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} murió, y más que eso, Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó. Ahora tiene el lugar de honor a la derecha de Dios, y habla con Dios a favor nuestro.

fr.L: Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} [est] celui qui est mort, et plus encore, qui a été ressuscité, qui aussi est à la droite de Dieu, qui aussi intercède pour nous.
fr.B: Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est celui qui est mort ; bien plus, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été ressuscité, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est à la droite de Dieu, où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} plaide en notre faveur.
fr.R: Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est mort, et plus encore, Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ramené à la vie. Maintenant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a la place d’honneur à la droite de Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parle à Dieu en notre faveur.

sw.L: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} [ndiye] yule aliyekufa, na zaidi ya hilo, alifufuliwa, ambaye pia yuko mkono wa kulia wa Mungu, ambaye pia anaomba kwa ajili yetu.
sw.B: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ndiye aliyekufa; zaidi ya hapo, alifufuliwa, naye yuko mkono wa kulia wa Mungu, ambapo anaomba kwa niaba yetu.
sw.R: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa, na zaidi ya hilo, Mungu alimfufua. Sasa ana nafasi ya heshima upande wa kulia wa Mungu, naye anazungumza na Mungu kwa ajili yetu.

decisions.choice: an answer: Christ, who died and pleads for us, is the one who could condemn and does not
alternatives: a further question: "Is it Christ who died ... who will condemn us?"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT punctuates the words as a statement. Read either way, the point is the same: the one who might judge is the one who died for us and speaks for us.

decisions.choice: "Christ"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts have "Christ Jesus"; others have "Christ" alone, which the SBLGNT follows. Some also add "from the dead" after "raised". (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: at the right hand of God: the place of honor and power
decisions.reason: The words echo Psalm 110:1, "Sit at my right hand". To sit at a king's right hand was to share his rule.

decisions.choice: intercedes: pleads on someone's behalf
decisions.reason: entugchanō is to approach someone for another, the verb used of the Spirit in verse 27. The Spirit pleads within believers, and Christ pleads for them before God (Hebrews 7:25).

decisions.choice: God raised him to life; the place of honor at God's right side
alternatives: was raised; at the right hand of God
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who raised him and explains "right hand" (m3).

decisions.choice: naye, no span
decisions.reason: Where the English Balanced and Readable say "he" for Christ, Swahili uses the verb prefix or "naye" (and he), in which the pronoun is joined to the conjunction and cannot take a capital, so there is no deity_pronoun span.

source.text: τίς ἡμᾶς χωρίσει ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Χριστοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: Who us will separate from the love of the Christ?

en.L: Who will separate us from the love of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}?
en.B: Who can tear us away from the love of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}?
en.R: Can anything take us away from the love {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has for us?

es.L: ¿Quién nos separará del amor {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}?
es.B: ¿Quién podrá arrancarnos del amor {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}?
es.R: ¿Puede algo apartarnos del amor que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} nos tiene?

fr.L: Qui nous séparera de l’amour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ?
fr.B: Qui pourra nous arracher à l’amour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ?
fr.R: Est-ce que quelque chose peut nous éloigner de l’amour que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a pour nous ?

sw.L: Nani atatutenganisha na upendo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}?
sw.B: Ni nani anayeweza kutung'oa kutoka katika upendo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}?
sw.R: Je, kuna kitu chochote kinachoweza kututenganisha na upendo ambao {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anao kwetu?

decisions.choice: the love of Christ: Christ's love for us
decisions.reason: The question is whether anything can cut believers off from the love Christ has for them, as verse 37 ("the one who loved us") and verse 39 ("the love of God") show.

decisions.choice: "of Christ"
decisions.reason: A few manuscripts have "the love of God", as in verse 39. Most have "of Christ", and the SBLGNT follows them. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: who: any person or thing
decisions.reason: The question begins with "who", but the list that follows names things, not people. Paul means anything at all.

decisions.choice: Can anything
decisions.reason: Readable says "anything", since the list that follows names things (m3).

source.text: θλῖψις ἢ στενοχωρία ἢ διωγμὸς ἢ λιμὸς ἢ γυμνότης ἢ κίνδυνος ἢ μάχαιρα;

records.literal_gloss: Trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

en.L: Trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
en.B: Trouble, or anguish, or persecution? Hunger, or lack of clothing, or danger, or the sword?
en.R: Can troubles or hard times? Can people who attack us because we belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}? Can hunger, or having nothing to wear, or danger, or a violent death?

es.L: ¿[Será] la aflicción, o la angustia, o la persecución, o el hambre, o la desnudez, o el peligro, o la espada?
es.B: ¿La aflicción, o la angustia, o la persecución? ¿El hambre, o la falta de ropa, o el peligro, o la espada?
es.R: ¿Pueden hacerlo los problemas o los tiempos difíciles? ¿Pueden hacerlo las personas que nos atacan porque pertenecemos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}? ¿Puede hacerlo el hambre, o no tener qué ponernos, o el peligro, o una muerte violenta?

fr.L: Détresse, ou angoisse, ou persécution, ou famine, ou nudité, ou danger, ou épée ?
fr.B: La détresse, ou l’angoisse, ou la persécution ? La faim, ou le manque de vêtements, ou le danger, ou l’épée ?
fr.R: Est-ce que ce sont les problèmes ou les moments difficiles ? Est-ce que ce sont les gens qui nous attaquent parce que nous appartenons au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ? Est-ce que c’est la faim, le manque de vêtements, le danger ou une mort violente ?

sw.L: [Je, ni] taabu, au dhiki, au kuteswa, au njaa, au kukosa nguo, au hatari, au upanga?
sw.B: Je, ni taabu, au dhiki, au kuteswa? Je, ni njaa, au kukosa mavazi, au hatari, au upanga?
sw.R: Je, matatizo au nyakati ngumu zinaweza? Je, watu wanaotushambulia kwa sababu sisi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wanaweza? Je, njaa, au kukosa nguo za kuvaa, au hatari, au kifo cha kikatili vinaweza?

decisions.choice: trouble and distress: outward pressure and inner anguish
decisions.reason: thlipsis is pressure and hardship; stenochōria is being hemmed in, with nowhere to turn. Paul pairs them in 2:9.

decisions.choice: sword: violent death, as by execution
decisions.reason: The sword stands for being killed by force, the fate of martyrs, as verse 36 goes on to say.

decisions.choice: persecution, famine, nakedness: what Paul himself had suffered
decisions.reason: Paul lists such hardships from his own life in 2 Corinthians 11:23-27. These are things that might seem to show that God had abandoned his people.

decisions.choice: people who attack us because we belong to Christ; a violent death
decisions.reason: Readable explains "persecution" and "sword" (m2) in plain words.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Readable names Christ, whose love verse 35 speaks of, and the title takes the usual setting.

source.text: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι Ἕνεκεν σοῦ θανατούμεθα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν, ἐλογίσθημεν ὡς πρόβατα σφαγῆς.

records.literal_gloss: As it has been written that: For the sake of you we are being put to death whole the day, we were counted as sheep of slaughter.

en.L: Just as it is written, "For {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sake we are being put to death all the day; we were counted as sheep of slaughter."
en.B: As it is written, "On {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} account we are being killed the whole day through; we are looked on as sheep for the butcher."
en.R: This is what the Scriptures say: "Because we belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, people try to kill us all the time. They think of us as sheep to be killed."

es.L: Así como está escrito: «A causa de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} se nos da muerte todo el día; fuimos tenidos por ovejas de matadero».
es.B: Como está escrito: «Por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} nos están matando el día entero; nos miran como a ovejas para el carnicero».
es.R: Esto es lo que dicen las Escrituras: «Porque {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenecemos, la gente trata de matarnos todo el tiempo. Nos ven como ovejas que van a ser sacrificadas».

fr.L: Selon qu’il est écrit : « À cause de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} nous sommes mis à mort tout le jour ; nous avons été comptés comme des brebis d’abattage. »
fr.B: Comme il est écrit : « Pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, on nous tue à longueur de journée ; on nous regarde comme des moutons pour l’abattoir. »
fr.R: Voici ce que disent les Écritures : « Parce que nous sommes à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, les gens essaient sans cesse de nous tuer. Ils nous considèrent comme des moutons qu’on mène à la mort. »

sw.L: Kama ilivyoandikwa, "Kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} tunakabiliwa na kifo siku nzima; tulihesabiwa kama kondoo wa machinjoni."
sw.B: Kama ilivyoandikwa, "Kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} tunauawa siku nzima; tunatazamwa kama kondoo wa kupelekwa kwa mchinjaji."
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo Maandiko yanavyosema: "Kwa sababu sisi ni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, watu wanajaribu kutuua wakati wote. Wanatuona kama kondoo wanaopelekwa kuchinjwa."

decisions.choice: a quotation of Psalm 44:23 (Hebrew numbering)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the psalm in the words of the Greek Old Testament. There God's people, faithful to him, cry out that they suffer for his sake. Paul applies their words to believers who suffer for Christ.

decisions.choice: "you" is God, to whom the psalm is spoken
decisions.reason: The psalm addresses God. Paul keeps its words; in his use, suffering "for your sake" is suffering for belonging to God and to Christ.

decisions.choice: all the day: all the time, continually
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of saying "without stopping".

decisions.choice: sheep of slaughter: sheep meant to be killed
decisions.reason: The Hebrew phrase means sheep set aside for slaughter, with no defense.

decisions.choice: Because we belong to you, people try to kill us
alternatives: for your sake we are put to death
decisions.reason: Readable says why they suffer and who causes it.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}
decisions.reason: The "you" of the psalm is God (m2), addressed in the singular, so the pronoun takes the deity_pronoun span, as in the English.

decisions.choice: siku nzima (L, B); wakati wote (R)
decisions.reason: "All the day" means all the time, continually (m3). "Siku nzima" (the whole day) keeps the picture in plain words; Readable says "wakati wote" as the English Readable says "all the time". The pronoun for God is the free possessive ("yako", "wako"), which takes the span.

source.text: ἀλλ’ ἐν τούτοις πᾶσιν ὑπερνικῶμεν διὰ τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντος ἡμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: But in these [things] all we more than conquer through the [one] having loved us.

en.L: But in all these things we are winning overwhelmingly through the one who loved us.
en.B: But in all of this we are winning, and winning by far, through the one who loved us.
en.R: But even in all these troubles, we win a complete victory with the help of the one who loved us.

es.L: Pero en todas estas cosas vencemos ampliamente a través de aquel que nos amó.
es.B: Pero en medio de todo esto estamos venciendo, y venciendo con mucho, a través de aquel que nos amó.
es.R: Pero aun en medio de todos estos problemas, obtenemos una victoria completa con la ayuda de aquel que nos amó.

fr.L: Mais en toutes ces choses nous remportons une victoire écrasante par celui qui nous a aimés.
fr.B: Mais en tout cela, nous sommes vainqueurs, et vainqueurs de loin, grâce à celui qui nous a aimés.
fr.R: Mais même au milieu de toutes ces difficultés, nous gagnons une victoire totale, avec l’aide de celui qui nous a aimés.

sw.L: Lakini katikati ya mambo haya yote tunashinda kwa ushindi mkubwa kupitia yule aliyetupenda.
sw.B: Lakini katikati ya haya yote tunashinda, tena tunashinda kwa mbali, kupitia yule aliyetupenda.
sw.R: Lakini hata katikati ya taabu hizi zote, tunapata ushindi kamili kwa msaada wa yule aliyetupenda.

decisions.choice: win overwhelmingly: win and more than win
decisions.reason: hupernikaō adds "beyond" to the verb "conquer". Believers do not only survive these things; through Christ's love they win a victory greater than the enemy's attack.

decisions.choice: the one who loved us: Christ, whose love is named in verse 35
alternatives: God, whose love is named in verse 39
decisions.reason: The past tense points to a single act of love, Christ's death (Galatians 2:20). Paul speaks of the same love as Christ's and God's (verses 35, 39), so the levels keep "the one who loved us".

decisions.choice: in all these things: in the middle of them, not by escaping them
decisions.reason: The victory is won while the troubles of verse 35 go on.

decisions.choice: winning overwhelmingly (L); winning, and winning by far (B); a complete victory (R)
decisions.reason: The familiar wording "more than conquerors" goes back to older English Bibles. The levels say in current words what the verb means (m1).

decisions.choice: vencemos ampliamente (L); estamos venciendo, y venciendo con mucho (B); obtenemos una victoria completa (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "win" with a prefix meaning "beyond": to win and more than win (m1). Spanish keeps it a verb, as the Greek is, and says how great the victory is, rather than use the noun phrase long familiar from older Bibles.

decisions.choice: nous remportons une victoire écrasante (L); vainqueurs, et vainqueurs de loin (B); une victoire totale (R)
decisions.reason: As in English, the familiar "plus que vainqueurs" belongs to older and current versions; the levels say in their own words that the verb means to win and more than win (m1).

decisions.choice: tunashinda kwa ushindi mkubwa (L); tunashinda, tena tunashinda kwa mbali (B); tunapata ushindi kamili (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "win" with a prefix meaning "beyond" (m1). Swahili keeps it a verb and says how great the victory is, avoiding the familiar wording of older versions. "Katikati ya" (in the middle of) gives the sense of "in all these things": victory in the troubles, not by escaping them (m3).

source.text: πέπεισμαι γὰρ ὅτι οὔτε θάνατος οὔτε ζωὴ οὔτε ἄγγελοι οὔτε ἀρχαὶ οὔτε ἐνεστῶτα οὔτε μέλλοντα οὔτε δυνάμεις οὔτε ὕψωμα οὔτε βάθος οὔτε τις κτίσις ἑτέρα δυνήσεται ἡμᾶς χωρίσαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: I am persuaded for that neither death nor life nor angels nor rulers nor things present nor things coming nor powers \v 39 nor height nor depth nor any creation other will be able us to separate from the love of the God the [one] in Christ Jesus the Lord of us.

en.L: For I am persuaded that neither death nor life, nor angels nor rulers, nor things present nor things to come, nor powers, \v 39 nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from the love of God that [is] in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus our Lord.
en.B: For I am fully persuaded that not death and not life, not angels and not rulers, not what is here now and not what is yet to come, not any powers, \v 39 not what is high above and not what is deep below, nor any other created thing, will be able to cut us off from God's love, which is ours in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus our Lord.
en.R: I am sure of this: not death, not life, not angels, not spirit rulers, not what is happening now, not what will happen later, not any powers, \v 39 not anything above us or below us, not anything else God has made, nothing at all can ever take us away from God's love. We have that love because we belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus our Lord.

es.L: Porque estoy persuadido de que ni muerte ni vida, ni ángeles ni gobernantes, ni cosas presentes ni cosas por venir, ni poderes, \v 39 ni altura ni profundidad, ni otra cosa creada alguna podrá separarnos del amor de Dios que [está] en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} nuestro Señor.
es.B: Porque tengo plena certeza: no podrán la muerte ni la vida, ni ángeles ni gobernantes, ni lo que existe ahora ni lo que todavía ha de venir, ni poder alguno, \v 39 ni lo que está muy arriba ni lo que está muy abajo, ni ninguna otra criatura, apartarnos del amor de Dios, que es nuestro en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} nuestro Señor.
es.R: Estoy seguro de esto: ni la muerte, ni la vida, ni los ángeles, ni los gobernantes espirituales, ni lo que pasa ahora, ni lo que pasará después, ni ningún poder, \v 39 ni nada que esté por encima o por debajo de nosotros, ni ninguna otra cosa que Dios haya hecho, nada en absoluto podrá jamás apartarnos del amor de Dios. Tenemos ese amor porque pertenecemos {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}} nuestro Señor.

fr.L: Car je suis persuadé que ni mort, ni vie, ni anges, ni principautés, ni choses présentes, ni choses à venir, ni puissances, \v 39 ni hauteur, ni profondeur, ni aucune autre créature ne pourra nous séparer de l’amour de Dieu qui [est] {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus notre Seigneur.
fr.B: Oui, j’en suis pleinement convaincu : ni la mort ni la vie, ni les anges ni les principautés, ni ce qui existe maintenant ni ce qui est encore à venir, ni aucune puissance, \v 39 ni ce qui est tout en haut ni ce qui est tout en bas, ni aucune autre réalité créée ne pourra nous couper de l’amour de Dieu, cet amour qui est à nous {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus notre Seigneur.
fr.R: J’en suis sûr : ni la mort, ni la vie, ni les anges, ni les esprits qui dominent, ni ce qui arrive maintenant, ni ce qui arrivera plus tard, ni aucune puissance, \v 39 ni rien au-dessus de nous ni au-dessous de nous, ni rien d’autre de ce que Dieu a fait, non, rien du tout ne pourra jamais nous éloigner de l’amour de Dieu. Nous avons cet amour parce que nous appartenons au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus notre Seigneur.

sw.L: Kwa maana nimesadiki kwamba si kifo wala uzima, si malaika wala watawala, si mambo ya sasa wala mambo yajayo, wala nguvu, \v 39 wala kimo wala kina, wala kiumbe kingine chochote hakitaweza kututenganisha na upendo wa Mungu ulio ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wetu.
sw.B: Kwa maana nina hakika kabisa kwamba si kifo wala uzima, si malaika wala watawala, si mambo yaliyopo sasa wala yale yatakayokuja, si nguvu zozote, \v 39 si vilivyo juu sana wala vilivyo chini kabisa, wala kitu kingine chochote kilichoumbwa: hakuna kitakachoweza kutukatilia mbali na upendo wa Mungu, ambao ni wetu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wetu.
sw.R: Nina hakika na jambo hili: si kifo, si uzima, si malaika, si watawala wa ulimwengu wa roho, si yanayotokea sasa, si yatakayotokea baadaye, si nguvu zozote, \v 39 si kitu chochote kilicho juu yetu au chini yetu, si kitu kingine chochote ambacho Mungu aliumba: hakuna kitu kabisa kitakachoweza kamwe kututenganisha na upendo wa Mungu. Tunao upendo huo kwa sababu sisi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wetu.

decisions.choice: I am persuaded: I have become convinced and remain so
decisions.reason: The perfect tense of peithō describes a settled conviction.

decisions.choice: angels, rulers, powers: spiritual beings
decisions.reason: Paul uses "rulers" and "powers" for spiritual forces in Ephesians 6:12 and Colossians 2:15, and here they stand beside angels. Whatever their rank, none of them can come between believers and God's love.

decisions.choice: height and depth: all space, above and below
alternatives: terms from astrology for the stars' high and low points
decisions.reason: The words can name the heights of heaven and the depths beneath the earth (compare Psalm 139:8). In astrology the same words were used of the stars' positions, which some believed ruled human life; Paul may include that idea. Either way, nowhere in all creation is beyond God's love.

decisions.choice: any other created thing: anything else in creation
decisions.reason: ktisis here is anything created. Everything that might threaten believers is itself something God made.

decisions.choice: "powers" after "things to come"
decisions.reason: Later manuscripts move "powers" next to "rulers", where it seems to belong; the earliest have it after "things to come", and the SBLGNT follows them. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: the love of God that is in Christ Jesus: God's love, given and known in union with Christ
decisions.reason: God's love is the love shown in Christ's death (5:8) and enjoyed by those joined to him. The chapter ends where it began, with those who are "in Christ Jesus" (verse 1).

decisions.choice: what is high above, what is deep below
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the two words mean (m3).

decisions.choice: spirit rulers
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of rulers are meant (m2).

decisions.choice: We have that love because we belong to Christ Jesus our Lord
decisions.reason: Readable ends with a short sentence that says what "in Christ Jesus" means (m6).

decisions.choice: gobernantes (L, B); gobernantes espirituales (R); poderes
decisions.reason: Rulers and powers are spiritual beings (m2). "Principados" and "potestades" are church words most readers no longer understand; "gobernantes" and "poderes" say what they are, and Readable adds "espirituales" as the English Readable says "spirit rulers".

decisions.choice: principautés (L, B); les esprits qui dominent (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians, "principautés" is the established French word for this rank of unseen powers; Readable says what kind of rulers are meant (m2), as the English "spirit rulers" does.

decisions.choice: watawala (L, B); watawala wa ulimwengu wa roho (R); kututenganisha
decisions.reason: Rulers are spiritual beings (m2); "watawala" (rulers) says what they are, where "enzi" (dominion) names a realm, and Readable adds "of the spirit world" as the English Readable says "spirit rulers". "Kututenganisha" (to separate us) is kept from verse 35 at Literal and Readable; Balanced says "kutukatilia mbali" (cut us off), as the English Balanced does.
